subject: Runbook & next steps: SDK onboarding, auth/routing, and JSON schema hardening
messages:
From: Priya Rao <priya@olivehealth.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: eng@olivehealth.com
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Thanks — follow-up and priorities from today's demo

Jonas / Redwood team,

Thanks for the demo earlier — that was helpful. A short recap from our side and what we'd like to see next: 

- Primary goal: onboard Redwood SDK into our inference path for clinical note summarization with strict JSON output for downstream billing and indexing.
- Key concerns: auth options (we prefer token-based but need to evaluate mTLS for our prod PII workflows), traffic routing (can we route by latency region + fallback to lower-cost model), and how Redwood enforces structured output reliably.
- Acceptance criteria for POC: 1) SDK integrated into staging within 2 weeks, 2) schema validation pass rate >= 99% on 5k sample docs, 3) fallback behavior defined for decoding failures.

Can you send a concrete runbook/playbook (steps, scripts, expected logs) and a recommended validation + retry pattern for constrained decoding and schema enforcement? Also please attach any quickstart artifacts and the example JSON schema you plan to use.

We'd like to lock a technical onboarding call next week (UTC-7 mornings). Procurement is watching timeline, so the sooner we get the runbook the better.

Thanks,
Priya Rao
Head of Platform Integrations
Olive Health

(Attachment: request_notes.pdf - pdf)

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Priya Rao <priya@olivehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks — follow-up and priorities from today's demo

Priya — great to meet you and the Olive team. High level response + next steps below. See attached quickstart and an initial schema (schema-v1.json).

High level plan (POC runbook):
1) SDK onboarding (target: 2 business days)
   - Install NPM/Py package and run quickstart (attached).
   - Wire API key for staging; optionally test mTLS using our test certs.
2) Auth options and recommendations
   - Start with scoped API key for staging. For prod PII we recommend mTLS + KMS-backed key rotation. We can provide a short script for cert install.
3) Routing policy
   - Route by region preference header (we expose region header) + cost-tier fallback. Example: US-W -> US-E fallback -> lower-cost quantized model if capacity spike.
4) Structured output reliability (constrained decoding + validation)
   - Step A: Constrain decoding with token-level constraints + prefix templates.
   - Step B: Validator step: run JSON schema validation (schema-v1.json) against output; log failures to our tracing hook.
   - Step C: Retry pattern: on schema failure, automatic retry up to 2 times with adjusted decoding params (higher top_p lower temperature, beam search with length penalty), then fallback to deterministic reranker path that uses embeddings to select closest valid candidate from cached outputs.
5) Canary & metrics
   - Run 5% canary for 24–48 hrs with enforcement flag on. Monitor schema pass rate, latency percentiles, token cost delta.

Action items I will take this afternoon:
- Share quickstart ZIP (attached) and canary-test-plan.md (attached).
- Populate a sample runbook doc in the shared Drive link.

Asks for Olive:
- Provide a 2–3 representative doc samples (sanitized) so we can run local schema pass-rate tests.
- Confirm a 60-minute slot next Tue or Wed AM (UTC-7) for technical onboarding.

I cc'd Marissa to drive the onboarding and Karthik to help with routing and reranker recommendations.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: redwood_sdk_quickstart.zip - zip)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, Priya Rao <priya@olivehealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Runbook & next steps: SDK onboarding, auth/routing, and JSON schema hardening

Priya / team — I'll take point on the hands-on onboarding. A few technical notes to supplement Jonas' plan: 

- Validation harness: we'll provide a small CLI that takes sample docs, calls Redwood in a local loop, and reports schema pass-rate + token distribution. This will let you tweak template prefixes before canary.
- Retry strategy detail: first retry = increase top_p to 0.95 and reduce temperature to 0.0; second retry = use beam=5, length_penalty=0.8, and explicit 'force-keys' prompt to include required fields. If both fail, call the reranker API that re-scores a small candidate set using embeddings; reranker returns highest-scoring valid JSON candidate or an error code.
- Embeddings / reranker integration: recommend refresh cadence of embeddings every 24 hrs for active records; score threshold 0.78 for automated acceptance, otherwise route to human review. We'll include a short script to compute nearest-neighbors and surface confidence.
- Logging & alerts: we'll hook into your Datadog trace with a schema_failure tag and set an alert when failure rate > 0.5% for 12 hrs.

I'll upload the CLI and a sample canary dashboard to the Drive by EOD.

Marissa Cole
Senior Product Manager, Integrations | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: canary-test-plan.md - markdown)

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Priya
